title: Three Seasons and One Short Fence
subtitle: 动物世界 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）
meta: 主题语境：动物世界（人与自然·自然生态·动物世界）　|　核心词汇：snake　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 snake 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1988 the keeper ① caught the snake that no child in the zoo would have recorded, and he said the catching was the whole of the season. The ② snake, meaning the reptile itself and not the fence, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a snake, he said, is the only thing in a zoo that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ snake in that zoo had the same short fence beside it, and the ④ snake at the far shed, meaning the calf they kept for the children to feed and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A snake, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the snake was the whole of the matter, meaning the danger and not the reptile. The ⑥ snake, meaning the danger and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; snake, he said, is either something you catch or the only word that means both a reptile and a danger. He said the danger is the part they remember.

By 1993 the ⑦ snake had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short fence. The ⑧ snake of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in March, was one zoo and three seasons of recording; snake, he said, is either the calf at the far shed or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ snake I remember is the reptile recorded in the register, which closed in 1995 and is still recorded as the quietest in the zoo. A ⑩ snake, my mother said in 1997, is the only reptile that improves by being recorded; every snake, she said, is a danger that has agreed to look like a reptile. She said the danger was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 蛇（指兽舍里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 蛇（指那条蛇本身，与矮矮的围栏相对）
C. 固定搭配：catch the snake 捉这一条蛇
D. n. 蛇（指留给孩子们喂的那一头）
E. n. 蛇之事（抽象总称，指一处兽舍的蛇之事）
F. n. 蛇（指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一条）
G. n. 蛇、凶险（指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 凶险（抽象总称，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: caught the snake that no child in the zoo would have recorded
The snake, meaning the reptile itself and not the fence
the snake at the far shed
the snake was the whole of the matter
the snake had become a line in a register
The snake of the whole thing
A snake, my mother said in 1997

answers.why: catch the snake 意为“捉这一条蛇”，1988 年那位饲养员把兽舍里没有一位孩子肯记载的一条蛇做了一遍。
snake 意为“蛇”，指那条蛇本身而不是矮矮的围栏，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被记载。
snake 意为“蛇”，指兽舍里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一道矮矮的围栏。
snake 意为“蛇”，指最远那间棚舍的留给孩子们喂的那一头，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
snake 意为“蛇、凶险”，指一件事里人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条凶险就是那件事的全部。
snake 意为“凶险”，指人人都喂却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条蛇，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
snake 意为“蛇”，指饲养台账里写到、被记载的那一条，到 1993 年这一条成了饲养台账里的一行。
snake 意为“蛇之事”，饲养员三月写道，整件事的蛇之事是一处兽舍和三个季度的记载。
snake 意为“蛇”，我记得的是饲养台账里记载过的那一条，1995 年养大了，至今仍被说成兽舍里最安静的一条。
snake 为抽象总称，母亲 1997 年说，蛇是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的蛇。
